decision.title: Welcome to My World
tracklist: Help Me Make It Through the Night
Release Me (And Let Me Love Again) (Live)
I Really Don't Want to Know
I'm So Lonesome I Could Cry (Live)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (10 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Welcome_to_My_World_(Elvis_Presley_album), https://www.discogs.com/release/4791870-Elvis-Presley-Welcome-To-My-World. 1977 RCA compilation (APL1-2274) of country-flavoured songs, a mix of live and studio cuts. 'I Can't Stop Loving You' (live, June 10, 1972 Madison Square Garden afternoon show) was previously unreleased; all other tracks had been previously issued. 10-track sequence identical across Wikipedia, Discogs 1992 CD reissue, MusicChartsArchive and RareVinyl UK LP listing. Certified Platinum by the RIAA.
